description.en: Sets a handle's opacity, either instantly (one value) or animated (a target alpha faded over a number of frames). The first argument can also be an array of handles to apply the same fade to all of them at once.
Handle to fade (character, image, bust-up, ...), or an array of handles to fade them all the same way.
Alpha value to set instantly, or the starting alpha when animating.
Optional target alpha to fade to.
True once the alpha (or fade) has been applied to the handle(s); null if the call was invalid (fewer than 2 arguments), or if a given handle doesn't resolve to an existing object.
